h1: B2B Lead Generation for Companies Selling to Tokyo
intro: Looking for a lead generation partner for Tokyo? Myntmore runs researched cold email, LinkedIn outreach and ABM for companies that want Japanese buyers, partners and distributors, including Indian manufacturers and IT firms. We work remotely from Mumbai, campaigns go live within 18 days, and the first qualified conversations usually arrive in weeks 3 to 4.
whyTitle: Why selling to Tokyo needs outbound

why.title: Buyers who value fit over volume
why.desc: Tokyo is home to manufacturers, trading houses and enterprise headquarters that choose suppliers carefully. A small, well-researched list beats a large blast every time.

why.title: Language and formality matter
why.desc: Many Japanese buyers expect outreach in Japanese and in a formal register. We agree the language, tone and who reviews the copy before anything is sent.

why.title: Partners open doors
why.desc: Trading houses, distributors and system integrators often decide who reaches the end buyer. Outreach can target those partners as well as direct buyers.

stepsTitle: How B2B lead generation works with us

steps.title: ICP and buying signals
steps.desc: We define who to target and which signals mean they are in-market: new plants and projects, overseas expansion, supplier reviews, partnerships and leadership changes.

steps.title: Lists, domains and copy
steps.desc: Verified contact lists, dedicated sending domains with warm-up, and copy written for Japanese buyers, in the language and tone agreed with you before launch.

steps.title: Campaigns go live
steps.desc: Cold email and LinkedIn sequences start sending in Japan business hours, with account-based plays for named companies and partners.

steps.title: Conversations, then consistency
steps.desc: First qualified conversations usually come in weeks 3 to 4, and meeting volume becomes consistent by weeks 6 to 8 as we tune messaging on real replies.

stepsNote: Outreach rules for this market: Japan's Act on the Regulation of Transmission of Specified Electronic Mail generally requires consent for advertising email, with exceptions such as business addresses a company publishes. Its APPI governs personal data. Campaigns are scoped with you, and with counsel, before launch. Read our [cold email compliance guide](/resources/blogs/cold-email-compliance-guide).
